$comment: Expense receipts for the Contoso Travel Concierge demo. The 'artifact' field is modality-neutral so the scenario can be reused across model capabilities WITHOUT changing this schema: the base (text) version sets type='text' and content=<extracted text>; a future vision version sets type='image' and uri=<image path>; a future voice version sets type='audio' and uri=<audio path>. Every modality resolves to the same structured receipt.
modality_note: Only 'type' + ('content' | 'uri') change between capability versions. Downstream policy and reasoning read the resolved fields (category, amount_usd, date), never the raw artifact.
